title: Difference arrays and deferred range updates

scope.target_population: Repeated warm calls to the exact linked image on the recorded host and collection window.
scope.ratio_orientation: candidate elapsed time divided by in-place elapsed time
scope.generalization_boundary: No cross-host, cross-build, allocator, distribution, online-operation, or universal-optimality claim.

design.assignment: Six ABBA and six BAAB complete blocks per main contrast and A/A campaign.
design.stopping: Fixed schedule. Pilot blocks were excluded. Missing or invalid periods would stop the phase without replacement.

unit_roles.randomization: one four-position ABBA or BAAB block
unit_roles.subsample: one timed candidate call within a process
unit_roles.generalization: one linked image on one recorded host and run window

design.model_boundary: Paired Student t intervals assume iid, approximately normal complete-block log contrasts. One host and build do not estimate host or build variation.

timer_quantization.boundary: Every position median was positive, so the frozen parser accepted the run. The confidence model does not include timer quantization.

aa.interpretation: Diagnostic only. This run does not prove absence of bias, establish a noise floor, or alter the primary family.

pilot.boundary: Counts include valid, partial, failed, timed-out, interrupted, and retried attempts. Timing inference still uses only complete valid blocks.

main.boundary: Counts include valid, partial, failed, timed-out, interrupted, and retried attempts. Timing inference still uses only complete valid blocks.

aa.boundary: Counts include valid, partial, failed, timed-out, interrupted, and retried attempts. Timing inference still uses only complete valid blocks.

profile.boundary: Counts include valid, partial, failed, timed-out, interrupted, and retried attempts. Timing inference still uses only complete valid blocks.

derived_work_counts.boundary: Counts describe selected logical operations and nominal scalar slots. They do not measure allocator metadata, every byte touch, sort moves, cache traffic, or bandwidth.

linked_image_disassembly.consumer_boundary: The linked image retains all four candidate symbols. The source-tree hash pins the black_box result consumer used after each timed call.

manual_timing_boundary_review.finding: The candidate call lies between Instant::now and Instant::elapsed. The result remains live until after elapsed. All four candidate symbols remain in the linked image.
